tool_args.rationale: The five paid rows vary both drive and gradient and remain in the subcritical regime. Fit the three-parameter shared siphon base plus open-sign local square-root branch numerically, retaining the stated warm-start rho near 0.70; no probe is needed.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five observations span u_now and s_grad with an explicit open-sign sqrt-branch model; the three coefficients are estimable without another measurement.
No temporal signature or long-horizon ambiguity is indicated; the provided task is a present siphon readout at fixed H.
All supplied s_grad values are at most 2.2, below the stated >2.36 regime requiring a high-gradient probe.
The authorized subtree and observed signatures support the siphon base; Haldane does not incorporate the observed sink-gradient dependence.
